content: {"decision":"answered","answer":"Burnside for rotations: only the identity fixes a valid coloring, because any nontrivial rotation would force each color count to be a multiple of 2 or 7, while the counts are 5,5,4. Counting labeled valid colorings by placements of the four C's gives 2324. The number of valid rotation classes before reflections is 166. For reflections, edge-axis reflections fix none, while a vertex-axis reflection fixes 28 valid colorings; the seven vertex reflections contribute 196. The dihedral Burnside count is (2324+196)/28=90. The number of distinct bracelets is 90.","missing_derivation":"","claims":[{"relation_id":"C02.rotation_classes","value":166,"quote":"The number of valid rotation classes before reflections is 166."},{"relation_id":"C02.bracelets","value":90,"quote":"The number of distinct bracelets is 90."}],"derivation_steps":[{"step_index":1,"statement":"Represent a valid coloring as a 14-cycle word with counts A=5, B=5, C=4 and adjacent letters unequal.","depends_on":[]},{"step_index":2,"statement":"For a rotation by k, fixed colorings are constant on cycles of length 14/gcd(14,k). Since 5,5,4 are not all divisible by 2 or 7, no nontrivial rotation fixes a valid coloring. Thus the rotation Burnside sum is only the identity count N.","depends_on":[1]},{"step_index":3,"statement":"Count N by placing the four C's. Nonadjacent 4-subsets of the 14-cycle number 14/10*C(10,4)=294. Each placement gives four positive gap lengths l1+...+l4=10 of A/B positions between consecutive C's.","depends_on":[1]},{"step_index":4,"statement":"For a placement with t odd gaps (t even), the number of A/B fillings with total A=B=5 is 2^{4-t} * C(t,t/2). Thus t=0 gives 16, t=2 gives 8, t=4 gives 6.","depends_on":[3]},{"step_index":5,"statement":"Classify C placements: t=4 when all four C's have the same parity, giving C(7,4)+C(7,4)=70. t=0 when parities alternate; then the even gaps must be 4,2,2,2, giving 14 placements. The remaining 294-70-14=210 placements have t=2.","depends_on":[3]},{"step_index":6,"statement":"Therefore N = 14*16 + 210*8 + 70*6 = 2324.","depends_on":[4,5]},{"step_index":7,"statement":"Rotation classes: since no nontrivial rotation fixes a valid coloring, Burnside gives N/14 = 2324/14 = 166.","depends_on":[2,6]},{"step_index":8,"statement":"For reflections, edge-axis reflections fix no coloring because every color count would have to be even, but A and B counts are 5. Vertex-axis reflections fix two opposite vertices. Parity forces those fixed vertices to be A and B; the six reflected pairs must then contain two A, two B, and two C.","depends_on":[1]},{"step_index":9,"statement":"A vertex-axis reflection reduces to a proper path of 8 vertices with fixed endpoints A and B and internal multiset A,A,B,B,C,C. For endpoints A,B, the two C's among the six internal vertices have 10 nonadjacent placements; their compatible A/B fillings sum to 1+2+1+2+1+2+1+1+2+1=14. Swapping A and B gives the same count, so one vertex-axis reflection fixes 28 colorings.","depends_on":[8]},{"step_index":10,"statement":"Dihedral Burnside: total fixed sum = 2324 + 7*28 + 7*0 = 2520. Divide by 28 to get 90 distinct bracelets.","depends_on":[6,9]},{"step_index":11,"statement":"Final counts: rotation-only classes 166; dihedral bracelets 90.","depends_on":[7,10]}]}
